images.note: 1846 Philadelphia war-theater map, copied from Gen. Arista's map captured at Resaca de la Palma; covers the Nueces-to-Rio Grande disputed strip and the whole theater. Contemporary (published during the war). No second-institution alt found at the bar.
images.source: Boston Public Library (Norman B. Leventhal Map Center) via Digital Commonwealth
images.title: A correct map of the seat of war in Mexico, 1846

images.note: Pre-war U.S. map showing Texas as admitted Dec 1845, before the war redrew the border; grounds the 'whose map says that?' fuse beat. Contemporary (1846). No second-institution alt found at the bar.
images.source: Boston Public Library (Norman B. Leventhal Map Center) via Digital Commonwealth
images.title: Map of the United States including Oregon, Texas and the Californias, 1846

images.note: Post-war U.S. map showing the new southwestern boundary after Guadalupe Hidalgo; visual for 'the country grew by a third' and the Mexican Cession (CA, NV, UT + parts of AZ, NM, CO, WY). Near-contemporary (1854, six years after the treaty). No second-institution alt found at the bar.
images.source: Boston Public Library (Norman B. Leventhal Map Center) via Digital Commonwealth
images.title: Colton's map of the United States, Mexico and the West Indies, 1854

images.note: Portrait painting of James K. Polk dated 1846, the year of the war message; beat is Polk's 'American blood upon the American soil' message of May 11, 1846. Contemporary; subject visually confirmed. No second-institution alt found at the bar.
images.source: Tennessee State Library and Archives (James K. Polk Collection)
images.title: James Knox Polk portrait, 1846

images.note: Portrait painting of Gen. Zachary Taylor in uniform; beat is Taylor's northern campaign (Palo Alto, Resaca de la Palma, Monterrey, Buena Vista). Undated but period uniform portrait; subject visually confirmed. No second-institution alt found at the bar.
images.title: General Zachary Taylor, portrait in uniform

images.note: Standing engraving of Winfield Scott 'from a photograph by Brady, expressly for this work'; beat is 'Old Fuss and Feathers,' the Veracruz landing and the Mexico City campaign. Brady-derived, ca. 1861 (later depiction of the wartime commander); subject visually confirmed. No second-institution alt found at the bar.
images.title: Winfield Scott, standing portrait in uniform (after Brady)

images.note: Engraving of John C. Calhoun by H.B. Hall from a Brady daguerreotype, with Calhoun's signature; beat is Calhoun's Southern 'common territory' position against the Wilmot Proviso. Period engraving; subject visually confirmed. No second-institution alt found at the bar.
images.title: John C. Calhoun, engraved portrait (after Brady daguerreotype)

images.note: 1856 ninth-plate daguerreotype of Henry David Thoreau by Benjamin D. Maxham (NPG, CC0); beat is 'Civil Disobedience' (1849) and the jail-over-the-poll-tax story. Near-contemporary (7 years after the essay). No second-institution alt found at the bar.
images.title: Henry David Thoreau, daguerreotype, 1856
